properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is the spine of Electrum's cryptography: build/packaging scripts (Android p4a recipe, Linux appimage, Windows wine, macOS) vendor libsecp256k1 into the shipped binaries, and the application performs secp256k1 ECDSA signing/verification and ECDH key agreement through the electrum_ecc wrapper (ecc.py). The one in-application site, lntransport.py:33, is live: `Noise_XK_secp256k1_ChaChaPoly_SHA256` names the BOLT-8 Lightning peer transport handshake — secp256k1 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256 + ChaCha2

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Confirmed sites use Python's Mersenne-Twister `random` mostly for non-secret purposes: reconnect/backoff jitter (interface.py:1110-1116), tx locktime privacy jitter / anti-fee-sniping (wallet.py:230-231), timestamp/nonce jitter (util.py:2194, 2465), Jade hardware-transport message IDs (jadepy/jade.py:350,1691,1766,1798,1813), deterministic calibration noise for the revealer overlay (qt.py:514). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 never appears standalone in this codebase — every one of the 17 sites is the Poly1305 tag inside the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD wrapper (chacha20_poly1305_encrypt/decrypt in electrum/crypto.py) and its LN callers. Same logical asset as ALG-3d4cff53, whose sites carry the per-site judgements.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-CBC is Electrum's workhorse bulk cipher: the aes_encrypt_with_iv/aes_decrypt_with_iv helpers (PyCryptodome, with a pyca/cryptography fallback) encrypt wallet payloads, plugin label-sync data and the BIE1 ECIES message format used by the cosigner-pool plugin; the Android Keystore biometric key in BiometricActivity.java is AES/CBC/PKCS7. The helpers themselves apply no MAC — authentication is the caller's job (ECIES adds HMAC-SHA256 separately). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
